game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Collapsed Passage, a half-collapsed passage: the lantern keeper must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Dam Filler: Raise the water level in a loop while level < max, without overflowing.
theme: Shadow Cave – Collapsed Passage: a half-collapsed passage
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Archive variation 3: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for C origins.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 10 before the lantern post is reached, or lives reach 0.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Dam Filler' (Week 4 slot 8), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Collapsed Passage'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how level changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Collapsed Passage.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The lantern post reached with actions_used <= 10.
source_player_objective: Reach the lantern post using at most 10 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The lantern post reached with actions_used <= 10.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 10 before the lantern post is reached, or lives reach 0.
